verdict.rationale: Productboard's own AI does related work: the built-in agent synthesizes information to take a new idea to delivery-ready, Spark can create Linear issues through natural language, and insights in feedback are detected automatically and linked to feature ideas. No documented flow takes a plain-language feedback description and produces a structured set of proposed tasks; insight linking connects feedback to existing feature ideas rather than proposing new tasks. Missing for 10: an explicit documented feedback-to-proposed-task-breakdown capability, a description of the structured task output and review/approval step, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI turn a plain-language feedback description into a structured set of proposed tasks

citations.quote: Go from new idea to delivery-ready in a fraction of the time. Productboard's built-in agent handles all the information synthesis
Productboard automatically detects insights within feedback that can be linked to related feature ideas.
Create & update Linear issues from Spark, check backlogs, project progress, and more.
